text:
marta: Quick design drop  proposing a leftrail 'compact index' that groups Models + Datasets under a single parent called 'Catalog' (visually compact, explicit breadcrumbs above canvas). Mock: https://staging.redwood/design/compact-index-v1.png

owen: I like the density win. Question: if someone lands on an external model link, should the left group auto-expand? My vote: reveal but do not steal focus. Breadcrumbs should show full path.

lucy: Copy: "Catalog" is short but maybe vague. Alternatives: "Assets index", "Data Catalog", "Models & Data". We could use "Catalog" with a microcopy line on hover "Contains Models and Datasets".

sam: Routing/infra notes: preserve permalinks. Plan: keep canonical routes `/console/w/:org/models/:id` and `/console/w/:org/datasets/:id` but accept client aliases `/console/w/:org/catalog/models/:id`. Add lightweight redirect table for legacy top-level links:```js
{ from: '/models/:id', to: '/console/w/:org/models/:id', status: 301 }
{ from: '/datasets/:id', to: '/console/w/:org/datasets/:id', status: 301 }
{ from: '/m/:id', to: '/console/w/:org/models/:id', status: 302 } // temp
```Persist UI state (split view, active tab) in querystring so deep links reproduce UI: `?view=split&tab=metrics`.

a11y-bot: a11y checklist: group header must be a real button (or role=button), support Enter/Space, expose `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Use an `aria-live="polite"` region for user-initiated toggles only (e.g., "Catalog expanded, 3 items"). Programmatic expands on route load should NOT steal focus.

marta: UX behavior idea: show a short dismissible banner when we launch: "Models now live in Catalog  Show me" (CTA opens tour). A/B test label: Catalog vs Data Catalog vs Models & Data. Track search fallback and nav click-through.

owen: Deep-link example we should support: `/console/w/acme/models/123?view=split&panel=metrics#insights`. Recommendation: normalize UI state to querystring and reserve hash for scroll anchors only. Middleware should preserve both on redirects.

lucy: Microcopy for banner: "Models and Datasets are now grouped under Catalog. See what's changed or take a guided tour." Buttons: "Show me" / "Take tour". Short CTA text: "Show" / "Tour".

sam: Implementation checklist for infra: add client aliasing from `/catalog/*` to canonical routes, server-side 301s for legacy shortlinks, persist panel state in querystring, emit `route:hydrated` event so components can sync without layout thrash, and debounce anchor scroll after hydration. I'll open a PR.

a11y-bot: keyboard specifics: header tabbable, arrow-key navigation inside group, ESC collapses group when focus is inside, skiplink to main content present. Breadcrumb must use `nav[aria-label="Breadcrumb"]` and last crumb `aria-current="page"`.

marta: Action items:
- @sam: infra tasks above (aliases, redirects, state persistence, route:hydrated event).
- @lucy: finalize label options and banner variants for A/B test; design tooltip microcopy.
- @owen: write acceptance criteria for focus and reveal behavior (no programmatic focus steal).
- @a11y-bot / rachel: include live-region wording and keyboard test steps in ticket.

Target: alpha rollout to staging next Wednesday. Any blockers? :thumbsup:

sam: No infra blockers. Will PR redirect table + middleware today and include tests for preserving query/hash.

lucy: I'll upload banner graphics and copy variants by EOD.

a11y-bot: Will run a quick NVDA/VoiceOver smoke once alpha is up. Note: debounce live messages to avoid spam during quick toggles.

marta: Great work. Pinning mock and test plan here.
